title: Chio Genesis Royalty Right (Proposed stub)
description: PROPOSED spec-shaped stub, deliberately located in the research tree, NOT in spec/schemas/. It documents the intended shape of the make-or-break Q2 artifact (a signed, non-transferable, forward-flowing claim on a fraction of the clearing fee that future hits to a finding generate). Registration into spec/schemas/registry.json, chio-core-types, and MANIFEST.sha256 happens at milestone G2 (the royalty right's owning milestone) (docs/research/cognition-market/GENESIS-PLAN.md); it is intentionally unregistered here so the canonical schema manifest is untouched by a research proposal. Design: GENESIS-ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.2, ADR-0018 D2.

beneficiary.description: Ed25519 issuer public key (64-hex). Bound here because the right is NON-transferable: there is no transfer operation, so the payee is fixed at grant time (ADR-0018 D2).

share_bps.description: Basis points of the clearing fee (net of operator spread) this right receives on a hit to finding_id.

step_down_schedule.description: Published bps steps keyed by elapsed genesis time (the TIER_DISCOUNT_PER_HUNDRED idiom, chio-appraisal/src/marketplace_pricing.rs:148). The share declines on this public schedule.

granted_by.description: The governance charter id that granted this right (the split authority).

expires_at.description: Genesis clock T_g; after this the share is 0.
